target.definition: standard Elo at the row snapshot

date_control.age: (snapshot month first day - exact Gregorian DOB).days / 365.2425
date_control.birth_season_phase: 2*pi*(Gregorian birth day-of-year - 1)/(366 if birth year is leap else 365)

pipelines.input_scaling: StandardScaler after model-specific expansion for Ridge/KRR/MLP; none for trees
pipelines.target_scaling: StandardScaler fitted inside each training fold, inverse-transform predictions for every metric

fixed.seed_policy: mean predictions across all three; never pick best seed

selection.candidate_order: listed family order then Cartesian-product grid order
selection.invalid_candidate: any numerical exception or nonfinite prediction invalidates candidate in that inner search
selection.convergence_warning: retain finite fit, report warning; do not expand iteration budget
selection.global_selection_rule: First candidate in fixed order with complete pooled OOF MAE <= the minimum complete candidate MAE + tie_tolerance_mae
selection.family_selection_rule: Independently apply the same minimum-plus-tolerance first-order rule within each family
selection.selected_model_storage: Explicit global selected_model; alias a family model only when candidate IDs match, otherwise preserve a separate selected fit

cv.final_search: same 4-fold inner CV independently within each prespecified final training subset; no external selection

cohorts: same 2023_M_NEW_TARGET500_WITH_TIES for all prespecified training subsets
models: all five families independently tuned on corresponding 2013 subset
size_comparison_metrics: paired external MAE difference for random 800 vs 500, 1000 vs 800, 1000 vs 500, separately for raw_A and date_control
secondary.size_comparison_interval: descriptive paired person-level percentile bootstrap, same 10000 resamples/seed as primary; no simultaneous coverage claim
secondary.reporting: joint complete report; no selecting best size, ranked cutoff, family, or seed from external performance

learning_curve.per_fold_seed: base seed plus zero-based outer fold index
learning_curve.outer_development_pool: exact random_1000, five outer folds with fixed 200-person test sets
learning_curve.subset_order: within each 800-person outer training fold, ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 str(20261024 + zero_based_fold_index) + newline + canonical_id
learning_curve.insufficient_fold_size: stop with documented input/configuration failure; do not relabel smaller sizes as 800
learning_curve.interpretation: internal CV training sizes 400,600,800 only; final externally evaluated 1000 model has no 1000-training-size CV estimate

expansion.reason: compare prespecified training sizes and rebuild independent-person 2023 cohort after expanding 2013

execution.current_workflow: Verify immutable analysis lock and tag; run 2013-only tasks; seal all fitted objects; jointly evaluate fixed external cohorts

supersedes: chess-single-A-v1 review draft; no v1 modelling or analysis-lock tag created

acquisition.status: initial NEW1000 attempt checkpointed; explicit amendment 01 restores original-sized NEW500 plus ties before fitting

development_pool.cutoff_ties: include all eligible members of complete cutoff Elo group

primary_evaluation.cutoff_ties: include all eligible unseen members of complete cutoff Elo group

acquisition.eligibility: active official standard-rating male; unique clean day-precision Gregorian DOB agreeing with official birth year when present; DOB on/before snapshot; confirmed northern birthplace latitude > 0
acquisition.legacy_annotations: reuse frozen eligibility/identity/DOB/hemisphere decisions with source references; do not refresh them opportunistically
acquisition.new_candidate_rules: reuse audited chess_north_v2 and chess_2023_cohorts_v1 adjudication rules, including temporal sanity check
acquisition.unresolved_or_conflicting: exclude and audit reason; no model-outcome-guided repair or source substitution
acquisition.scan_stop: only after completing rating group reaching target; checkpoint and resume same rules if interrupted
new_target_excludes: entire expanded 2013 development pool including all cutoff ties
acquisition.canonical_identity: normalized decimal identity_bridge_modern_fide_id if present else fide_id
acquisition.final_file_paths: record in post-acquisition data_manifest.json before analysis freeze
acquisition.new_claim_calendar_rule: retrieve and retain Wikidata calendar model; accept explicit Gregorian only; exclude missing/unknown/non-Gregorian with reason; no implicit conversion
acquisition.legacy_calendar_rule: inherit existing Gregorian interpretation, record legacy_calendar_not_reverified; earlier query did not retrieve calendar model
acquisition.supplementary_full: from same completed 2023 candidate audit: Top1000 eligible plus cutoff ties before seen/unseen exclusion; not independent validation
acquisition.collector_commit: record exact executing commit in acquisition run manifest before first new DOB collection

amendment_01.reason: correct assistant additional NEW1000 assumption to original approximately500 evaluation scope; recorded after acquisition coverage/network checkpoint, before fitting or predictive scores

training_subsets.canonical_id_order: normalized decimal identity strings, lexicographic where an ordering is required
training_subsets.random_order: ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 string str(20261024) + newline + canonical_id; canonical_id breaks hash ties
training_subsets.random_subset_uncertainty: single prespecified draw; does not estimate all training-subset variation
training_subsets.ranked_rule: rating descending; include every eligible development-pool player tied at the kth rating; record actual n
training_subsets.ranked_interpretation: sample size and Elo/population-range change jointly
training_subsets.identical_subset_policy: deduplicate fitting when canonical-ID sets match, retain every prespecified result label
